scope: Local personal research product. Status describes implementation and available verification, not investment performance. Earlier paid/provider/browser evidence is reused; read-only endpoint checks do not refresh external data.

status_definitions.verified: Implemented with the listed software, saved live or browser evidence. Each row states which evidence exists.
status_definitions.experimental: Implemented and exercised, with research-quality or generalization limits.
status_definitions.partial: Only the stated subset is implemented or available.
status_definitions.unconfigured: Adapter exists and offline contracts pass; actual external integration has not been verified.
status_definitions.not_implemented: Not delivered as a working product capability.

features.name: Local Deep Agents / LangGraph with Doubao Pro
features.zh: 本地 Deep Agents / LangGraph + 豆包 Pro
features.verification: Real Pro research/report and follow-up jobs completed; configuration read back from running service.
features.limit: Authorized /api/plan/v3 only. Provider failures remain possible; no Lite or extra-billing fallback.

features.name: Flexible tools, host terminal and Python SDK
features.zh: 通用工具、真实终端与 Python SDK
features.verification: 12 business tools and 8 framework tools asserted; real terminal/socket capture and registered custom calculation exercised.
features.limit: Trusted local host execution; not a multiuser OS sandbox. Analysis methods remain optional.

features.name: Four progressively loaded research skills
features.zh: 四个按需加载的研究 skill
features.verification: Packaged research, quantitative-analysis, strategy-research and portfolio-analysis skills; clean-wheel skill discovery checked.
features.limit: Skills guide methods; they do not force a fixed tool sequence. Synchronous subagent delegation is disabled.

features.name: Session checkpoints, traces, stop and recovery
features.zh: 会话保存、任务轨迹、停止与中断恢复
features.verification: SQLite conversation persistence, cancellation, provider-format repair and abandoned-job recovery tests; saved live traces retained.
features.limit: Continuing failed work is explicit; failed drafts do not become valid answers.

features.name: ETH/BTC quotes and completed candles
features.zh: ETH/BTC 行情与已结束的小时／日 K 线
features.verification: Saved real provider receipts and current dashboard endpoint inspected; normalization and unfinished-bar tests pass.
features.limit: Single-venue USD data, with source and retrieval times. Cached success is not proof of freshness.

features.name: Returns, volume, volatility, drawdown and ETH/BTC comparison
features.zh: 收益变化、成交量、波动率、回撤和 ETH/BTC 对比
features.verification: Window alignment, missing observations, completed-bar time and reproducible calculation contracts tested.
features.limit: Descriptive indicators, not predictive guarantees; volume and turnover are different quantities.

features.name: Funding rates and open-interest snapshots
features.zh: 资金费率与持仓量快照变化
features.verification: Saved OKX source availability inspected; same-interval funding and same-contract OI arithmetic tested.
features.limit: One venue/contract. OI change uses an explicit saved interval and includes repricing, not proven capital inflow.

features.name: Visible spread/depth and hypothetical purchase cost
features.zh: 盘口价差、可见深度与假设买入成本
features.verification: Partial coverage, price bands, VWAP and full intended-fee handling tested; saved real book available.
features.limit: Top saved levels only; no guaranteed fill, latency model or order placement.

features.name: DeFi TVL, stablecoins, DEX activity and Aave fees
features.zh: DeFi TVL、稳定币、DEX 活动及 Aave 费用数据
features.verification: Saved real source receipts and per-source dashboard status inspected; normalization tests preserve native units and gaps.
features.limit: Provider coverage varies; stocks, flows, fees and revenue are distinct metrics.

features.name: Read-only Ethereum RPC and bounded Aave WETH analysis
features.zh: 以太坊只读 RPC 与限定范围 Aave WETH 分析
features.verification: Saved real RPC/event capture and ABI/filter tests; available through terminal SDK.
features.limit: Specific pool/reserve/block window only. Historical liquidity may be unavailable; not full-chain inflow or buying pressure.

features.name: Broader macro, ETF, liquidation and consensus coverage
features.zh: 更全面的宏观、ETF、清算及共识指标
features.verification: Optional archive adapters and explicit missing-data behavior exist; comprehensive live coverage is not accepted.
features.limit: No claim of complete live coverage; unavailable or permission-limited fields remain gaps.

features.name: Web search, publisher feeds and original-page capture
features.zh: 联网搜索、新闻源与原文抓取
features.verification: Real Pro search/original-page workflow completed; citation annotations, extraction and raw-integrity tests pass.
features.limit: Search excerpts are separate from originals; publication dates may be unknown; search uses configured provider quota.

features.name: Persistent news, event revisions and correction timeline
features.zh: 新闻保存、事件版本及更正时间线
features.verification: Reviewed source-backed event revisions, cutoff tests and browser timeline accepted; running API retains saved versions.
features.limit: Event grouping/classification is an analyst judgment. Saved versions are not a large independently observed revision corpus.

features.name: Cross-session recall of evidence and prior research
features.zh: 跨会话召回证据与历史研究
features.verification: News FTS/lexical recall, original source identity, answer-context index and restart behavior tested; actual saved context recalled.
features.limit: Prior AI conclusions are research context, not a new fact source or current user preference.

features.name: Relevance, MMR and coverage evidence selection
features.zh: 相关性、MMR 与 coverage 证据选择
features.verification: Budget, time, duplicate and linked-update contracts; frozen matched selector comparisons completed.
features.limit: Lexical training-free methods; coverage scored below relevance/MMR in the pilot. Context cost is an estimate.

features.name: Manual research questions and reviewed answers
features.zh: 主动提问与来源审核后的回答
features.verification: Real Pro current-data and saved-history answers completed; numeric, unit and source gates tested.
features.limit: Separate-context review uses the same model family and remains fallible AI assessment.

features.name: Structured reports and publication gates
features.zh: 结构化报告及发布核验
features.verification: Real report publication with numeric and source support checks; failed-review/export drafts retained.
features.limit: Attribution is inspectable, not guaranteed truth. Unsupported claims must be revised, removed or qualified.

features.name: Claim-to-original evidence reader
features.zh: 逐条结论与原始证据并排阅读
features.verification: Report and chat advice/history citation mapping checked in desktop/mobile browser; exact-quote contracts tested.
features.limit: Unmatched citation context falls back to source view; quote integrity alone does not establish semantic correctness.

features.name: Registered autonomous Python calculations
features.zh: 模型自主编写并登记可复现计算
features.verification: Real terminal calculation rerun, recipe/input hashes, lineage and publication-number checks.
features.limit: Unregistered terminal prose is not automatically citable. Reproducibility does not prove a method is suitable.

features.name: Evidence ZIP, integrity verification and offline replay
features.zh: 证据包导出、完整性验证及离线重放
features.verification: Real report package integrity and custom recipe replay passed; tampering, missing-file and traversal cases tested.
features.limit: Local exports can contain cited private portfolio data; public source delivery excludes them. Archived code replay executes on the host.

features.name: Saved report history and changes
features.zh: 历史报告与内容变化对比
features.verification: Immutable earlier reports and literal claim/source/judgment diffs tested; browser comparison inspected.
features.limit: Literal wording differences are not automatically material market events.

features.name: Evidence-linked conditional suggestions
features.zh: 连接数据与来源的条件性建议
features.verification: Real current-data advice published; conditions, counterpoints, invalidation, gaps and review triggers validated/reviewed.
features.limit: No established accuracy rate, causal price effect or profitable investment edge.

features.name: Qualified historical-case reasoning
features.zh: 有来源及适用范围的历史案例参考
features.verification: Real saved-experiment follow-up; case end, receipt time, underlying inputs and transfer limits tested.
features.limit: Unavailable analogies remain gaps; retrospective observations are not promoted to point-in-time evidence or invented win rates.

features.name: Research preferences and paper scenarios
features.zh: 研究期限、风险偏好与假设方案比较
features.verification: Unknown versus explicit-zero context, loss scenarios and common-window buy/hold, staged-entry and momentum calculations tested.
features.limit: Defaults are labelled assumptions; hypothetical loss is not a probability estimate or actual P&L.

features.name: Manual USD/ETH/BTC ledger and CSV operations
features.zh: 手工 USD／ETH／BTC 台账及 CSV 操作
features.verification: Atomic imports, duplicates/conflicts, void/restore and export tests; disposable UI acceptance completed.
features.limit: Actual ledger currently empty; no demo holdings inserted. Manual records are not exchange-verified balances.

features.name: FIFO basis, fees and realized/unrealized P&L
features.zh: FIFO 成本、费用及已实现／浮动盈亏
features.verification: Exact cash/fee accounting, transfers, cutoff and missing-mark/basis cases tested.
features.limit: Unknown basis remains unknown. This is not tax accounting and excludes unrecorded outside holdings.

features.name: Read-only portfolio context and purchase constraints
features.zh: 持仓关联研究与买入约束预览
features.verification: Private snapshot lineage and cash/concentration/depth/conditional-loss preview tested.
features.limit: Business analyst has no ledger-write tool. Preview is not a trade or complete suitability assessment.

features.name: Local logistic/tree training and walk-forward evaluation
features.zh: 本地逻辑回归／树模型训练与滚动评估
features.verification: Real saved completed-OHLCV experiment and model inspection; temporal labels, purging, refit and future-invariance tests.
features.limit: Small inspectable research baselines, not demonstrated professional forecasting or validated profitable models.

features.name: Cost-aware common-window simulations and exports
features.zh: 同区间含成本策略比较与实验导出
features.verification: Common calendar/costs, delayed execution, baseline comparisons, artifact JSON and deterministic report tested.
features.limit: Idealized daily-open fills; no real latency/market impact. Repeated experiments weaken holdout independence.

features.name: Persistent once/daily/weekly briefs and interval monitors
features.zh: 持久化单次／每日／每周简报及间隔监测
features.verification: Real scheduled report completed; timezone, restart, duplicate prevention and bounded retry tests.
features.limit: Local computer and service must run. Three saved product schedules are currently disabled; no new schedule was enabled in this review.

features.name: Changes-only triggers and in-app run status
features.zh: 仅变化触发、应用内提醒与执行状态
features.verification: Quiet baseline, unchanged-no-model-call, busy deferral and saved run-state tests; status UI inspected.
features.limit: Thresholds are user monitoring preferences. External email/SMS/push channels are not implemented.

features.name: English Home, Research and Portfolio workspace
features.zh: 英文 Home、Research、Portfolio 三入口工作台
features.verification: Real desktop/390px checks of three primary destinations, nested news/reports/updates, embedded chat, optional preferences and More menu; existing evidence/history access preserved.
features.limit: ETH is the primary workspace and BTC a comparison asset; not an arbitrary-asset trading terminal.

features.name: Persistent inbox, comparison point and disconnected recovery
features.zh: 持久化收件箱、比较基准及断线恢复
features.verification: Seen state, irregular quote-baseline semantics and CSRF tests; real disconnect/reconnect and reload acceptance.
features.limit: Saved quote change is not personal profit. Reconnect does not silently restart model research.

features.name: Offline application regression and clean-wheel startup
features.zh: 离线回归与干净安装启动验证
features.verification: 167 tests across 26 modules, offline harness probe and isolated wheel-state acceptance; no paid model calls in software tests.
features.limit: Dependencies reused from locked local runtime; Linux/Python-version CI is configured but not remotely executed here.

features.name: Frozen historical and memory evaluations
features.zh: 冻结历史与 memory 评测
features.verification: Saved 3-case historical gate pilot; 13 official-source snapshots, 12 groups, 39 probes and 77 frozen contract checks.
features.limit: Small, AI-authored pilot labels and current captures; not a large independent market benchmark.

features.name: Matched paired Pro answers and recorded failures/costs
features.zh: 配对 Pro 回答对比及失败／消耗记录
features.verification: Four fixed cases by three selectors produced 12 outputs with shared inputs/model and actual token/latency records.
features.limit: No same-model truth judge; response-mode agreement is not semantic accuracy. No statistically established improvement.

features.name: Independent human adjudication and richer real revision histories
features.zh: 独立人工复核及更丰富的真实更正历史
features.verification: Explicit gap preserved in acceptance and evaluation guide.
features.limit: Labels await independent review; twelve independently observed multiversion real event histories are not available. New tuning needs untouched confirmation data.

features.name: Jev external semantic assessment
features.zh: Jev 外部语义检测
features.verification: Offline adapter validation/abstention/credential tests plus one authorized real event-status smoke test on 2026-10-23: jev-1.14.0, expected synthetic planned status, 588 input/63 output tokens, 1.223 seconds.
features.limit: Separate TypeSafe credential. Three-stage integration and task/report quality remain unverified. No price-prediction claim.

features.name: Public-chain audit anchoring
features.zh: 公开链证据哈希存证
features.verification: Contract/client and local EVM tests retained; public Sepolia probe lacked test funds.
features.limit: No verified public deployment/transaction. Optional audit dependencies are separate; no mainnet deployment.

features.name: Exchange sync, automated orders and public multiuser deployment
features.zh: 交易所同步、自动下单及公开多用户部署
features.verification: No working exchange-order or account-sync integration is delivered; service is loopback-only.
features.limit: Current release is a local single-user research application, not a broker, cloud service or production account system.

features.name: RPC resilience and bounded capability observations
features.evidence: 23 offline transport cases plus low-load real cache/header/log probe
features.boundary: Provider maxima unknown; archived state authorization gap

features.name: Frozen per-signal evaluation
features.evidence: 4960 real bars,18 cases,23 variants,three cost scenarios; exact saved-source replay
features.boundary: Retrospective single venue; full-model Brier did not beat the constant prior aggregate baseline

features.name: Optional strategy-code workshop
features.evidence: Two real Deep Agents/Pro author/reviewer rounds, all artifacts, final code lock and8 confirmation cases
features.boundary: Selected source has a deterministically reproduced mean-formula bug and is blocked for correction; no promotion or orders

features.name: Optional advanced research panel
features.evidence: Local API and desktop/mobile acceptance; disabled state and core compatibility tests
features.boundary: Argo is not integrated and funding arbitrage is deferred
